title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film 'the right way' and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy | TechCrunch
summary: Even as Hollywood remains divided over the use of AI in filmmaking, actor and director Mark Wahlberg believes the technology has a place in the industry as long as it’s used the right way.
